ingredients.title: Shrimp
items: 1/2 cup vegetable oil, or more, as needed
Kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper, to taste
1 1/2 lb medium shrimp, peeled and deveined

instructions.title: Slaw
items: Combine cabbage, sour cream, mayonnaise, cilantro, garlic, lime juice and salt in a large bowl; set aside.

instructions.title: Sauce
items: Whisk together mayonnaise, sweet chili sauce, honey and Frank's hot sauce in a small bowl; set aside.

instructions.title: Shrimp
items: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together buttermilk, flour, cornstarch, egg and hot sauce; season with salt and pepper, to taste.
Working one at a time, dip shrimp into buttermilk mixture, then dredge in panko, pressing to coat.
Working in batches, add shrimp to the skillet and cook until evenly golden and crispy, about 2-3 minutes. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate.

instructions.title: To serve
items: Serve immediately with tortillas and slaw, drizzled with sweet chili sauce and garnished with cilantro, if desired.
